message: The [SuspendInvariantsAttribute] aspect cannot be applied to the method '{0}' because the IsInvariantSuspensionSupported contract option is not enabled for the type '{1}'. Enable this option in ContractOptions using a fabric.
title: The [SuspendInvariantsAttribute] aspect cannot be applied to the method because the IsInvariantSuspensionSupported option is not enabled for its declaring type.
rationale: The title contains a stray '$' ('[$SuspendInvariantsAttribute]', because of '$' inside an interpolated string) and the duplicated determiner 'the its'. The message gives no way forward although the fix is always to set ContractOptions.IsInvariantSuspensionSupported (report site: SuspendInvariantsAttribute.BuildAspect).
codeChange: The definition of LAMA5004 (and of LAMA5005) in ContractDiagnostics.cs omits the category argument "Metalama.Patterns.Contracts" that the other contract diagnostics pass. In C#, keep the nameof() interpolations and write the title as $"The [{nameof(SuspendInvariantsAttribute)}] aspect ..." without the '$' inside the string. SuspendInvariantsAttribute.BuildAspect does not call builder.SkipAspect() after reporting the error, unlike the LAMA5005 branch; consider skipping the aspect.
